US Suspends Tech Firms, Including Microsoft, From Green Card Program

The U.S. administration has suspended Microsoft, Infosys, TCS, Adobe, and Wipro, along with five other firms, from participating in the green card program. The New York Times reported the suspension of Microsoft from the green card program, alleging visa fraud by the Trump administration. The Economic Times mentioned that Trump plans to honor Microsoft's CEO, while Senator Vance has taken action against the company regarding H-1B visas. Microsoft has issued clarifications regarding its H-1B visa hiring practices.
